## Content pass — 2026-09-04

455 text nodes rewritten from placeholder to a coherent **vehicle-distributor** scenario.
Domain chosen because the imagery in the file is cars (Range Rover hero, sports cars on mobile,
a full Toyota Camry XSE spec page) and images **cannot** be replaced via the plugin API —
`createImageAsync` is unsupported — so the copy was matched to the pictures, not the reverse.

What changed: `Ultra Comfort Ergonomic Office Chair` ×90+ → 10 real vehicles with matching
descriptions and prices · `Price: 10000£/€` → real prices · `button` → `Add to basket` ·
`quoation` → `Request quote` · `Foulen ben Foulen` / `person` / `Regular user` →
Karim Haddad, Buyer · Auto Nord · sidebar `name` ×3 → Orders / Catalogue / Invoices ·
`View latest shipmments` → `shipments` · filter facets Apple/Samsung/Screen Size/Storage →
Toyota/Renault/Body type/Fuel · `Category name` ×30 → real categories, `You can add contact`
×30 → vehicle counts · `Ice Cream.JPG` → registration / service-history / warranty PDFs ·
`© 2026 Levelset Inc.` → `© 2026 ZUMConnect` · chair specs on the car detail page → vehicle
specs · lorem everywhere → real copy.

**Why WebP:** the PNG exports totalled **6,988 KB**; at WebP q=88 they are **1,254 KB** — 83%
smaller with no visible loss on UI text. `site/` is now 3.2 MB total. PNG masters are kept in
`archive/case-zumconnect-png-masters/`.

## Re-export + optimise (the whole loop)

1. `get_screenshot(fileKey='ufGm25MdD3Qb0VMWFvjwyf', nodeId, maxDimension = the frame's own height)`
   — mobile frames export at native 375 wide.
2. Download the returned URL to a `.png`.
3. Convert and replace:

```python
from PIL import Image
Image.open('zc-home.png').convert('RGB').save('zc-home.webp','WEBP',quality=88,method=6)
```

4. Move the PNG to `archive/case-zumconnect-png-masters/`.
5. Bump `styles.css?v=N` in all 8 pages if CSS changed. **Filenames are reused**, so if you
   overwrite a `.webp` in place, add a `?v=N` to its `src` or browsers will serve the old one.
